title: UK economics consultancy research catalogue
limitations: This is a curated catalogue, not a census of the economics consulting market.
Person entries include research names and historical context. Inclusion does not establish a complete or verified biography.
Related professional source links concern selected statements or appointments, not every aspect of a person’s career.
Only individually source-checked financial fields are included. Missing information is not zero; reporting entities, periods and accounting bases differ.
Appointment dates retain their original basis: announcement, intended start, actual start or statutory appointment. A missing end date does not establish a current role.
Registered offices are dated legal addresses, not necessarily working offices. International locations are an illustration of ten firms’ published office/contact lists.
Brand, catalogue scope, legal entity and university/service-line identities remain distinct. Organisation links are only supplied where their relationship is explicit.
No personal holdings, private research notes or raw dossiers are included. Role histories, education, founding and ownership details are omitted unless specifically source-checked.
